question: Which of the following number is NOT divisible by 8?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Any number divisible by 8 must be an even number because 8 is even.

Check the last digit of each option: 2736 (6), 5237 (7), 4360 (0), 5536 (6).

Since 5237 is an odd number, it cannot be divided by 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 5237.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Numbers: 2736, 5237, 4360, 5536

Rule: A number is divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8.

⇒ For 2736: Last three digits are 736. 736 ÷ 8 = 92 (Divisible)

⇒ For 5237: Last three digits are 237. 237 ÷ 8 = 29.625 (Not Divisible)

⇒ For 4360: Last three digits are 360. 360 ÷ 8 = 45 (Divisible)

⇒ For 5536: Last three digits are 536. 536 ÷ 8 = 67 (Divisible)

⇒ Only 5237 fails the divisibility test for 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 5237.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 2ⁿ

A number is divisible by 2ⁿ if its last n digits are divisible by 2ⁿ (e.g., last 2 digits for 4, last 4 digits for 16).

Divisibility by 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3 or 9 respectively.

Divisibility by 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.
